hero.headingLead: Get the latest jobs on your
hero.subheading: ScrapJobs monitors company career pages, finds opportunities that match your profile, and sends new jobs directly to you.
hero.microcopy: Answer 3 questions and see how many jobs we found for you.
hero.chatDigest: 8 new jobs today — Company A, Company B. Open: scrapjobs.com.br/d/...

howItWorks.title: See your opportunities in 3 questions
howItWorks.description: The initial conversation identifies what you are looking for and shows the number of jobs before you choose a plan.

profile.title: Tell us what you want
profile.body: Share your field, experience level, and preferred locations.

result.title: See the result
result.body: ScrapJobs checks available jobs and shows how many match your profile.

plan.title: Choose your plan
plan.body: Subscribe to access the opportunities and receive the next matching jobs automatically.

howItWorks.note: The conversation and initial search are free. Job access and continuous monitoring are included with a subscription.

included.title: From job discovery to application
included.description: Each resource solves one part of the job search. Together, they reduce repetitive work and help you decide which jobs are worth applying to.

radar.title: Job radar
radar.body: Monitors company career pages several times a day.

selection.title: Personalized selection
selection.body: Filters jobs according to your profile and preferences.

alerts.title: Job alerts
alerts.body: Delivers opportunities through your chosen channel: WhatsApp or email.

analysis.title: Compatibility analysis
analysis.body: Compares a job and your résumé, highlighting strengths, gaps, and keywords.

prompt.title: Optimization prompt
prompt.body: Generates instructions to adapt your résumé in ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini.

included.promptNote: The prompt prepares personalized instructions for you to use with your PDF in another AI. ScrapJobs does not rewrite your résumé or generate a new one.

norte.title: Norte on WhatsApp
norte.body: Search jobs, request analyses, send your résumé, and change preferences in a conversation.

dashboard.title: ScrapJobs dashboard
dashboard.body: Track jobs, monitored companies, résumés, and settings.

origin.question: Where do the jobs come from?
origin.answer: From the career pages of monitored companies, checked several times a day.

initialFree.question: Is the initial conversation free?
initialFree.answer: Yes. You answer three questions and see the number of jobs. Access and continuous monitoring require a subscription.

whatsapp.question: Do I need WhatsApp?
whatsapp.answer: The initial flow and verification happen on WhatsApp. Afterwards, you can change the alert channel to email and use the web dashboard.

curriculum.question: Does ScrapJobs modify my résumé?
curriculum.answer: No. It analyzes compatibility and generates a prompt to use in another AI together with your PDF.

cancel.question: Can I cancel at any time?
cancel.answer: Yes, with no lock-in, directly from the dashboard.

company.question: Can I request another company?
company.answer: Yes. Send the career-page URL and the team will assess whether it can be added to monitoring.

footer.disclaimer: The brands, logos, and company names displayed belong to their respective owners and are used for identification purposes only. ScrapJobs has no affiliation, sponsorship, or endorsement from these companies.

ctaFinal.title: Stop searching for jobs every day.
ctaFinal.subtitle: Tell us what you want and let ScrapJobs monitor company career pages for you.
ctaFinal.microcopy: Start with 3 questions and see the result before choosing a plan.

pricing.title: Choose how much you want to monitor
pricing.subtitle: Both include alerts, dashboard, Norte, compatibility analysis, and an optimization prompt.
pricing.footer: Monthly billing · no lock-in · cancel anytime from your dashboard

benefits.channel: Delivery channel via WhatsApp or email
